title: Workflow example: filter rows, select relevant columns, rename for clarity
description: A three-step workflow that filters the dataset to a subset of rows, keeps only the relevant columns, and renames them for readability. Use this pattern when the user wants a focused, clean extract of their data: 'show me the high-value transactions with clear labels'.
example_query: 筛选销售额超过1000的记录，只显示地区和销售额，并把sales改成总销售额
planning_notes: Filter first to reduce the dataset, then select columns to drop irrelevant fields, then rename to match the user's preferred labels. Always apply filter before select_columns so that the filter can reference columns that may not be in the final output.
